0022600115.text: The Timberwolves, 2-0 and 7th in the West, host the 2-0 Toronto Raptors, who are 4th in the East. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), while Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (out, heel surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Minnesota won both matchups in 2025-26, most recently 115-107 in Minneapolis on March 5, 2026.
